basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a recent college grad from the Midwest, diving into the world of Reddit to learn and share. My interests are a mix of gaming, especially betting on CS:GO matches, and exploring quirky online communities. Not a fan of MLM schemes and love capturing adventures with my GoPro. I'm currently working as a project assistant, trying to transition into a full-time project management role. Usually online during the evenings and weekends. Single and enjoying the freedom to explore new hobbies!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained experience in project management through an internship during college and lots of self-study. Developed a knack for CS:GO betting by watching streams and researching strategies. Recently, I've been learning about video editing through GoPro tutorials.
